slug: EXT. CHINATOWN (SOLEDAD STREET), SALINAS, CA — DAWN
source: Dances With Fetty.fountain (Drive Google Doc, modified 2026-09-18) — newest draft; supersedes 'First 45 Minutes Dances with Feddie' (2026-08-17) for this scene
summary: Paul, sick and looking to score, walks Soledad Street at dawn; the block is dry. Killa, holding court in Dorothy's middle cubbyhole, offers him 'blues' instead, until a G-Wagon on white Forgiatos slides onto the block. Out front of the Moongate, Ruby, awake since dreaming her granddaughter Dances overdosed, reads guilt on Rick and Tina, runs them off, and then trades barbs with her born-again daughter Season.

emotional_beats.beat: A grandmother's fear, hardening into suspicion and anger (Ruby)
Family acid: Ruby's armor against Season's faith

characters: background: residents, users, dealers, people at the Victory Mission
